format: ASCII single line: kind=K key=value ... common_fields\n; space-separated unique keys; no quoting; register and count numbers use 0x hexadecimal
authority: New explicit generation-3 component; v1/v2 files, pins, receipts and raw logs remain unchanged.

file_contract.open: fopen(path, wx), exactly one log= argument
file_contract.flush: fwrite exact line length + fflush + ferror checked for each line
file_contract.maximum_file_line_derivation: begin1 + candidate1 + scope32 + poweron16 + late48 + producer48 + sharedfault32 + end1
file_contract.host_console: No observation output. Only fixed bounded fatal host diagnostics on stderr if file/format/open/close or install argument handling fails.
file_contract.close: end.close_result remains unknown. Actual normal owned exit, whole log readback and unchanged run/receipt/source closure are required. Any scope/producer conflict, known-anchor change, fault, host diagnostic or abnormal exit rejects the whole claim; retain raw bytes.

candidate.candidate_base: 0x followed by 16 hex digits; unbound scope candidate only

entry.ordinal: per-slot successfully written complete record count 0x1..0x10
entry.actual_pc: exact 8B register read, 16 hex digits after 0x
entry.translated_entry_pc: same PC as actual_pc, from matching instruction translation
entry.candidate_base: B, an unbound low-48-bit nonzero page-aligned candidate
entry.x0: exact 8B little-endian read, 16 hex digits after 0x
entry.x19: exact 8B little-endian read, 16 hex digits after 0x
entry.x20: exact 8B little-endian read, 16 hex digits after 0x
entry.x21: exact 8B little-endian read, 16 hex digits after 0x
entry.x23: exact 8B little-endian read, full 64 bits, 16 hex digits after 0x
entry.x24: exact 8B little-endian read, full 64 bits, 16 hex digits after 0x
entry.x29: exact 8B little-endian read, 16 hex digits after 0x
entry.x30: exact 8B little-endian read, identical to lr
entry.cpsr_raw: exact4 little-endian original raw CPSR, nRW bit0x10 clear; no normalization
entry.cpsr_m: cpsr_raw & 0x1f, 2 hex digits; original mode retained
entry.context_mode: EL0t when cpsr_m=0, otherwise other_aarch64; all records remain unbound. Original Main identity consumer must separately require EL0t.
entry.sp: exact 8B and 16 hex digits after 0x if named sp is available; otherwise unknown
entry.sp_read_length: 0x8 if sp present and read; 0x0 if sp unavailable
entry.ttbr0_el1_available: 0x1 only when descriptor TTBR0_EL1 was found and exact8 read succeeded; otherwise 0x0 when absent
entry.ttbr0_el1_raw: full 64-bit raw target value, 16 hex digits after 0x; unknown when absent; no PID/TID/ASID interpretation
entry.tpidr_el0_available: 0x1 only when descriptor TPIDR_EL0 was found and exact8 read succeeded; otherwise 0x0 when absent
entry.tpidr_el0_raw: full 64-bit raw target value, 16 hex digits after 0x; unknown when absent; not a PID/TID
entry.api_ok: 0x1; every attempted register read returned bool true; x2 is not read or required by scope

poweron_context.ordinal: independent successfully written complete poweron record count 0x1..0x10, shared across all unbound poweron bases
poweron_context.actual_pc: exact8 little-endian raw PC, 16 hex digits after 0x; must equal translated_entry_pc
poweron_context.translated_entry_pc: PC of first exact matched patched dispatcher instruction, candidate_base + 0x1951844
poweron_context.candidate_base: unbound low-48-bit nonzero page-aligned B derived independently of the scope candidate; multiple poweron bases are allowed without identity claims
poweron_context.controller: exact8 little-endian raw x0, full64, 16 hex digits after 0x; no pointer normalization or memory dereference
poweron_context.raw_x2: exact8 little-endian full64 x2, 16 hex digits after 0x; high32 preserved
poweron_context.caller_raw: exact8 little-endian full64 x30, 16 hex digits after 0x; no normalization
poweron_context.cpsr_raw: exact4 little-endian original raw CPSR, 8 hex digits after 0x; no normalization
poweron_context.cpsr_m: cpsr_raw & 0x1f; exactly 0x00 for successful poweron records
poweron_context.context_mode: EL0t; this condition alone never establishes original AP identity
poweron_context.ttbr0_el1_available: 0x1 only for enumerated descriptor plus successful exact8 read; 0x0 if descriptor absent
poweron_context.ttbr0_el1_raw: full64 raw value, 16 hex digits after 0x; unknown when absent; not a PID/TID or globally unique ASID
poweron_context.ttbr0_el1_read_length: 0x8 when present and exact; 0x0 when absent
poweron_context.ttbr0_el1_api_ok: 0x1 when actually read successfully; unknown when absent and unattempted
poweron_context.tpidr_el0_available: 0x1 only for enumerated descriptor plus successful exact8 read; 0x0 if descriptor absent
poweron_context.tpidr_el0_raw: full64 raw value, 16 hex digits after 0x; unknown when absent; not a PID/TID or unique address-space identity
poweron_context.tpidr_el0_read_length: 0x8 when present and exact; 0x0 when absent
poweron_context.tpidr_el0_api_ok: 0x1 when actually read successfully; unknown when absent and unattempted
poweron_context.x2_read_length: 0x8; raw_x2 and raw_u32 come from the same full64 read
poweron_context.api_ok: 0x1; every attempted core and optional-token register read returned bool true

fault.reason: reason-specific literal; consumes only the shared bounded fault quota and no scope or poweron success quota
fault.poweron_unknown_x2: Runtime unknown_register with reg=x2, required_length=0x8, read_attempted=0x0, read_length=0x0, api_ok=0x0. Missing x2 does not disable scope initialization or execution.
fault.poweron_mode_rule: Matching raw plus non-EL0 AArch64 produces reason=poweron_not_el0t with context_mode=other_aarch64. AArch32 produces reason=not_aarch64. Original CPSR and M are retained in both; no successful poweron row. Scope still observes all AArch64 modes raw.
fault.noncandidate_rejections: Scope different or unbound entry: bad address, short TB, instruction shape/copy/bytes mismatch are silent. Only the exact known scope entry can produce disabling anchor_changed. Poweron address/shape/copy/bytes/partial mismatches, including later translations at a previous matched PC, are always silent. Multiple exact poweron bases are not fatal or bound candidates.
fault.other_raw: After successful exact8 x2 read, nonmatching w2 mask returns before any other read; emits no record or fault and increments no counter or quota.

end.stop: none|anchor_changed|ambiguous_base|vcpu_limit|invalid_callback_context|register_list|duplicate_register|unknown_register|host_io_failure|install rejection reason|producer_anchor_changed|producer_base_conflict (any non-none rejects the whole group)|producer2_anchor_changed|producer2_base_conflict (both reject the whole group)
end.ambiguous: 0x0|0x1; scope ambiguity invalidates all earlier observations
end.candidate_found: 0x0|0x1; scope candidate only, independent of poweron observations
end.candidate_base: first scope candidate or 0x0000000000000000 when none
end.conflicting_base: first conflicting scope base or 0x0000000000000000; never inferred from poweron bases
end.poweron_records: successfully emitted complete poweron_context records, 0x0..0x10; zero for the parent scope-only synthetic fixture
end.faults: saturating uint64 total, 16 hex digits after 0x
end.suppressed_faults: saturating uint64 count beyond independent 32-line fault budget
end.other_lr: saturating uint64 nonmatching valid scope LR reads; no quota or diagnostic consumption
end.late0_records: successfully flushed records of fixed late site 0, 0x0..0x10
end.late1_records: successfully flushed records of fixed late site 1, 0x0..0x10
end.late2_records: successfully flushed records of fixed late site 2, 0x0..0x10
end.late_sequence: number of successful late records across all 3 sites, 0x0..0x30
end.producer_anchor_found: 0x0|0x1; independently frozen exact24B code-pattern candidate only
end.producer_base: full64 16-hex first unbound producer base, or all-zero when not found
end.producer_conflicting_base: full64 16-hex conflicting producer base, or all-zero; nonzero rejects all evidence
end.producer0_records: complete flushed entry rows 0x0..0x10; not invocation pairs
end.producer1_records: complete flushed pre_M_store rows 0x0..0x10; not store completions
end.producer_sequence: successful producer rows across all three sites 0x0..0x30; not an invocation identifier
end.producer2_anchor_found: 0x0|0x1; second writer independent exact24B anchor found flag
end.producer2_base: full64 first second-writer unbound base, zero exactly when producer2_anchor_found=0x0
end.producer2_conflicting_base: full64 second-writer conflicting base or all zero; any nonzero rejects group
end.producer2_records: complete flushed second_entry rows 0x0..0x10; not store or return completions

identity_binding_required_outside_plugin.runtime_reference: Original Main SHUTTER_DETAIL_POWERON site=dispatch ... base/controller/caller/raw plus observation_only=1; supplied Main56c code installed the 16B stub and prior parent-owned runs read back original16 and patch16. This extension neither opens Sony binaries nor rechecks those earlier runs.
required_external_bindings: same new run and original Main dispatch record
poweron candidate_base equals the independently known original Main runtime base
poweron controller, caller_raw and raw_u32 agree with the actual original Main dispatch controller/caller/raw fields; do not normalize or manufacture the full64 raw_x2
scope candidate_base equals that bound Main base; scope and poweron have compatible raw CPSR EL0t contexts
scope and bound poweron raw TTBR0_EL1 and TPIDR_EL0 values agree with actual availability and exact read lengths; absent tokens cannot be treated as equal or sufficient identity evidence
raw tokens are contextual correlation material, not PID/TID, globally unique ASIDs, or stand-alone address-space proof
frozen original assets, same-run manifest and source set
frozen observer source and independently plugin-capable candidate QEMU build
not_proven: global uniqueness of head24 or the patched 8B pattern
PID/TID/address-space identity from VA, bytes, EL0t or raw tokens alone
GDB PC freshness for every instruction callback
instruction retirement, branch target or callee return
identity_binding_required_outside_plugin.legacy_binaries: Existing e235/a0d binaries have no plugin exports per delegation; no loadability or modification claim.

instruction_contract.callback: First matched instruction, before execution, QEMU_PLUGIN_CB_R_REGS; GDB PC is read raw and must equal translated_entry_pc, but API 7 does not guarantee per-instruction PC refresh. Synthetic proof at a TB-entry anchor does not generalize to other instructions.
instruction_contract.resources: One immutable scope candidate context; first different scope base or changed known scope entry disables all collection. Exactly one configured/runtime vCPU; <=4096 register descriptors; 14 saved named register references. Scope does not read x2.
instruction_contract.optional_token_api_evidence: QEMU target/arm/helper.c descriptors are exactly TTBR0_EL1 and TPIDR_EL0; target/arm/gdbstub.c builds dynamic AA64 sysreg XML from ri->name and exposes 64-bit raw values. Enumerate only; never synthesize absent descriptors. Present token read failure rejects the entire attempted entry or poweron row and consumes only fault quota.

poweron_instruction_contract.address_rule: Untagged zero-extended low48 entry and all 8B within low48; B=entry-0x1951844 must be nonzero and page aligned
poweron_instruction_contract.callback: Before the first LDR instruction; R_REGS; no literal read, target inference, replay or patch write
poweron_instruction_contract.discovery_order: Independent of scope candidate discovery; exact patched poweron TB translated before scope still receives its callback immediately
poweron_instruction_contract.execution_filter: Read x2 exact8 first. Only (uint32_t(x2)&0xff000fff)==0x01000090 proceeds; then actual PC must match and CPSR.M must be exactly EL0t. Other raw values emit no record/fault or counter increment.
poweron_instruction_contract.userdata: Immutable low48 matched PC encoded with (void *)(uintptr_t)entry and decoded via uintptr_t, never dereferenced. Requires a flat 64-bit host with UINTPTR_MAX==UINT64_MAX (compile-time assert); no per-TB allocation, mutable shared poweron candidate, retained instruction handle or userdata free.
poweron_instruction_contract.multiple_bases: Raw per-record unbound candidates only; do not pick a first base as AP or apply scope ambiguity to these generic 8B patterns. Parent joins the known Main base and content.
poweron_instruction_contract.synthetic_fixture: The parent-owned scope-only six-word fixture contains no patched poweron stub; it must emit no poweron_context and end.poweron_records must remain 0x0

source.boundary_proof: Inherited complete entry-through-RET linear body; no LDR, call or branch; not inferred from a neighboring function or index size alone. No claim about all possible indirect entries.
source.input_abi: w0 is a direct u32 value. Incoming x0 is never dereferenced by this body. full64 x0 must be retained; only low32 is the STR operand. Neither zero upper32 nor pointer semantics is required.
source.input_pointer_case: This producer is not the pointer case. If future inherited source only establishes a pointer argument, retain raw register only, proposed_u32=unknown and input_kind=unknown_pointer; do not dereference it or add a site without closed source.

sites.destination_rule: Record full64 x1_raw. Checked uint64 addition x1_raw+0x2f0 must equal B+0x7e6a7c8 without overflow; expected x1=B+0x7e6a4d8. Do not dereference destination. A mismatch is a bounded fault and no complete successful pre-store row.

translation.event_pc: Copied insn_vaddr for the selected instruction in the exact same-TB six-instruction anchor; no cross-TB reconstruction.
translation.base: B=anchor_entry-0x276e710; nonzero, page aligned, untagged zero-extended low48, complete anchor and checked static destinations within uint64/allowed low48 bounds.
translation.copy_api: Official API7 qemu_plugin_insn_data(insn, local4, 4) must return exactly 4 for each size4 instruction with continuous addresses. Compare all 24 inherited bytes, including uninstrumented second STR and RET.
translation.callbacks: Writer0 before-instruction indices0/3; writer1 before-instruction index0 only. No store/branch/RET retirement claim.
translation.pc_semantics: gdb_pc_raw is exact8 but may be lazy at either site. event_pc comes from immutable translation metadata. Do not require raw PC equality or silently replace it with event_pc; actualAPI fixture must demonstrate correct operand registers at both taps.
translation.userdata: Use the existing flat64-host opaque packed eventPC/site integer convention; derive B/site with checked fixed offsets, never dereference userdata. No retained insn handle, guest pointer, per-TB heap allocation or mutable callback metadata.
translation.ordinary_collisions: Before a writer exact anchor is frozen, short/mismatched same-TB windows remain silent. A changed known writer0 entry disables the group as producer_anchor_changed; a changed known writer1 entry as producer2_anchor_changed. Exact conflicting bases reject across both writers and scope in every discovery order.
translation.scope_unchanged: Scope/poweron/late exact fields and policy unchanged; writer0/writer1 freeze independent base/found state and reject every base conflict with each other or scope in any discovery order.

register_contract.required: Clear GByteArray storage and length before each read; descriptor found is independent of handle!=NULL. Official qemu_plugin_read_register returns bool true and exact length: pc/x0/x1/x30=8, cpsr=4. Same exact8 read feeds x30_raw and caller_raw; no truncated reread.
register_contract.optional_present: Enumerated descriptor -> attempted read must bool true/exact8, otherwise fault rejects the entire row.
register_contract.optional_absent: available=0x0, raw=unknown, read_length=0x0, api_ok=unknown; never zero-fill a token.
register_contract.context_fields: cpsr_raw 8 hex digits; cpsr_m=cpsr_raw&0x1f 2 digits; nzcv=cpsr_raw&0xf0000000 8 digits; nzcv_mask=0xf0000000. nRW bit0x10 must be clear; modes 0,4,5,8,9,12,13 retained. CPU0 only.
register_contract.other_value_fields: x0_raw,x1_raw,x30_raw,caller_raw,gdb_pc_raw,event_pc,candidate_base use full 16 lowercase hex digits after 0x; raw_input_u32/proposed_u32 use 8 when known; no value filtering, no W0==1 assumption.
register_contract.prestore_read_budget_max: 8 attempted reads, 60 target bytes: pc/x0/x1/x30/sp/TTBR0/TLS 7*8 plus CPSR4; absent optional reads are not attempted.
register_contract.entry_read_budget_max: 7 attempted reads, 52 target bytes: omit x1; x1 fields absent in entry site schema.

producer_identity_contract.producer_candidate_state: Each exact writer anchor freezes its own entry/base/found independently of the other writer and scope. second_entry never requires writer0 found.
producer_identity_contract.early_execution: Immediately collect actual rows for either exact writer independently of scope/other writer discovery; scope_anchor_seen is the actual scope candidate bit at that callback. Never delay, replay, rewrite or synthesize an unobserved writer row.
producer_identity_contract.late_scope: Later scope candidate must equal provisional producer B. Same-B early raw rows remain unchanged; new reader may report retrospective_context_match_only, with earlier_AP_identity_unknown=true, if actual same-run Main/poweron and exact context tokens match. No fabricated earlier Main observation or earlier scope anchor.
fail_closed: Any discovered nonzero scope/writer0/writer1 bases must all agree in every order; found flags and zero absent bases must match; rows require their own writer found.
Any second exact producer anchor at a different B disables the whole new evidence set, including earlier rows, even before scope discovery.
Producer B and scope B conflict in either discovery order: disable, retain conflicting full64 bases and an ambiguity fault/end state, no join.
Existing second scope B or known-anchor changes retain existing fail-closed behavior.
No exact producer callback records means normal input/caller/proposed value unknown, even when an anchor was translated.
No same-run Main binding, absent/short token or mode mismatch leaves raw producer rows uncorrelated; it is not proof of missing initialization/write.
producer_identity_contract.context_join: Parent validates frozen same-run assets/normal owned exit/full immutable trace. Original Main 35-field dispatch base/controller/caller/raw joins actual poweron record as before. Producer B must equal bound Main/scope B; CPU0, cpsr_m=0 EL0t, enumerated+successful exact8 TTBR0_EL1 and TPIDR_EL0 must numerically match that bound context. Exact raw tokens and availability are mandatory, absent != absent. Existing scope/late later-order rule is preserved; early producer matches get a distinct retrospective status only.
producer_identity_contract.EL1: Retain raw known AArch64 EL1 modes as other_aarch64 and unbound; never normalize to EL0t or claim original AP. AArch32/reserved or invalid mode is a bounded fault; no complete successful row.
producer_identity_contract.caller_followup: A correlated actual entry raw caller LR is the next precise source-selection key. Keep full64 raw, optionally derive LR-B arithmetically if checked in-range; LR-4 is only a candidate call instruction address, not proof of BL/BLR or dispatch. A future separately bounded inherited-source check must show that actual instruction and registration/slot consumer before assigning M ID/key/record grammar. No broad caller/writer/table scan is authorized by this contract.
producer_identity_contract.normality: The plugin observes invocation; 'normal original caller' requires later source/event evidence. Main context correlation alone does not establish normal dispatch or a transaction ID.
producer_identity_contract.PID_TID: Always unknown in plugin. Parent may cite same-run Main raw LF/PID/TID as reported line references, never label token or producer callback with proven PID/TID.

raw_record_contract.encoding: ASCII unique key/value tokens with single spaces and LF
raw_record_contract.preservation: Every original line retains full raw bytes as hex, LF-inclusive SHA256/length/offset and ordered canonical field pairs. No raw row is rewritten, backfilled or recoded as v1.
raw_record_contract.late_order: Existing scope/late observations require an earlier bound poweron context.
raw_record_contract.early_producer: Matching later Main/poweron only permits retrospective_context_match_only and earlier_AP_identity_unknown=true. Raw identity/binding always unknown/unbound.
raw_record_contract.no_row: Input, caller and proposed value unknown; anchor or exit0 does not prove absence of a normal invocation or M write.
raw_record_contract.pairing: Three independent site lists; either entry-only or pre-store-only allowed. No pairing by ordinal and no completed store/return inference.
